core_obligations: Replace the cover: choose an algebraic space mapping smoothly and surjectively onto the cover, note that the composite to the target is surjective flat and locally of finite presentation, and use the definition of the property for the base-changed morphism to obtain it for the new base change (proof lines 5788-5805)

Present the morphism: choose smooth presentations of the target and of the fibre product so that the induced morphism of algebraic spaces becomes the one whose property is at issue (proof lines 5806-5816)

Base change and descend: after base changing by the covering space everything remains smooth, the hypothesis gives the property for the base-changed presenting morphism, and fppf locality on the target gives the property for the presenting morphism, hence for the morphism of stacks (proof lines 5817-5829)
proof_roadmap: 取代数空间 W → Z 满光滑 ⇒ W → Y 满平坦局部有限表现；由 P 的定义（沿展示检验）与光滑局部性，可把 Z 换成 W。
再取 V → Y 与 U → V ×_Y X 满光滑；只需证 U → V 有 P。
把一切沿 W → Y 基变换，得 U' → V' 有 P（由假设）；再由 P 在目标上的 fppf 局部性回到 U → V，即 f 有 P。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces which is smooth local on source and target and fppf local on the target descends from a flat finitely presented surjective base change to the morphism of algebraic stacks itself (author lemma at source lines 5776-5786, label lemma-descent-property). The proof (source lines 5788-5830) replaces the covering stack by a smooth presentation, presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, base changes the whole presentation along the cover and applies the two locality properties to descend the property (proof lines 5788-5829). The presentation of the morphism and the two locality steps are the substance. H3.
